explanation: A king of Judah who reigned for 29 years and succeeded his father Joash; known for his victory over the Edomites and conflict with Israel.
King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz, who fought against Amaziah and defeated him, expanded Israel's territory, and plundered the temple in Jerusalem.
Son of Joash and king of Israel; during his reign Israel experienced a period of prosperity and expansion.
An Old Testament kingdom southeast of the Dead Sea, inhabited by descendants of Esau, Jacob's brother; conquered by Amaziah but later revolted.
A person who receives and delivers messages from God; in 2 Kings 14 a prophet is sent to Amaziah to warn him against attacking Israel.
Precious metal symbolizing wealth and power; Amaziah took gold from the temple in Jerusalem after defeating the Edomites, but lost it to Joash.
Precious metal that also symbolizes wealth and power; Amaziah took silver from the temple along with the gold, but lost it to Joash.
